notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing. Two WebSearch queries plus cached pages (FFLA Wisconsin lists, OSM node, WXPR 2015, FFLA 2019 chapter report) yield only name, county, coordinates, standing status and OSM elevation. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing, access or rental source found. Record matches FFLA and OSM on name, county, location and status; no corrections proposed. Search returned TopoQuest place pages for other features (Basswood Lookout Tower, Langlade County); not cited. WXPR date comes from the article URL (2015-12-21). The WXPR and FFLA 2019 items are statewide context only; neither names this tower. Leads to try: Wisconsin Historical Society Architecture and History Inventory, WDNR tower divestment records, Langlade County forestry or historical society. Confirm land ownership before any access advice.
